name: Strength
drives: melee damage, carry weight, chopping/mining power

name: Vitality
drives: max HP, max Energy, defense, hunger resistance, rest recovery

name: Agility
drives: dodge, action speed, travel time, ranged accuracy

name: Perception
drives: crit chance, rare finds when foraging, spotting ambushes, extra lore

name: Intellect
drives: crafting quality, research/learning speed, recipe discovery, trade pricing

name: Spirit
drives: Qi capacity (later), cultivation speed, rest efficiency, willpower in dialogue
